notes: Exercise the Clause 8 example in which a joined federate that is not time-regulating sends an interaction with a timestamp. The receiver must observe the supplied logical timestamp unchanged. This contract is limited to the interaction example and does not claim TSO coordination, a valid retraction handle, or behavior for other message families.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped Send Interaction from a joined sender without Time Regulation; FederateAmbassador timestamped interaction callback
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador sendInteraction with LogicalTime; FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction with LogicalTime
